text: Biomedical Engineering (BME) is an interdisciplinary field that integrates biology, medicine, engineering, materials science, and computer science. Its core lies in "using engineering techniques to solve problems in the medical and health fields". Through the development of medical equipment, the construction of biological materials, and the design of diagnosis and treatment plans, it builds a bridge between "engineering technology" and "life health". From the commonly used blood glucose meters to high-end artificial hearts and CT scanners, all of these are supported by the technical capabilities of Biomedical Engineering.
